record_title: Scale-thinning rigidity for the one-dimensional centered Hardy--Littlewood maximal norm
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem is one-dimensional and does not determine the norm for radius sets confined to a compact annulus, the weak (1,1) endpoint, or higher-dimensional exact constants. The dyadic-radii special case is treated as prior coverage. The full text of arXiv:2609.12440 was not directly inspected; its abstract was checked and a detailed public review was used conservatively to exclude the reported dyadic case from the originality claim. Recency leaves a residual risk of unindexed or uninspected broader coverage. No independent validation is asserted.
